title: Les Invalides: Domes, Light and Quiet Details
description: Twelve photographs explore Les Invalides in Paris: gilded details, stone arches, church interiors and the changing light beneath the dome. Explore the still photographs behind the film. Music: "French France Paris Music" by lNPLUSMUSIC via Pixabay.
